title: Create commits from staged changes
description: Provide a commit workflow that commits only the staged index and accurately reports author and resulting commit state.
acceptanceCriteria: The user can enter and validate a commit message and create a commit from staged changes only.
Empty index, invalid identity, hooks/errors, and engine failures produce actionable states without false success.
Success shows the verified commit SHA and updates branch/history/status consistently.
Commit author configuration follows the selected architecture and never leaks credentials.

steps.description: Inspect commit APIs and author identity behavior
steps.details: Follow the selected engine's documented commit semantics.
Keep staged and unstaged changes separate.
Cover empty index, invalid message/identity, and failed commit.

technicalNotes: Do not push automatically after committing unless a future explicit product decision adds that behavior.
